note: The plain-English catalogue of the Folio flows, printed by the handover packs (npm run handover) and read by the Central Administration Centre, which watches every flow in it. Group and purpose are written here; the trigger was read from the tenant on 2026-10-20. expectedState is Started unless stated.

flows.name: CG_Submission_Endpoint
flows.purpose: Receives a submission from the public, issues its NITDA-YYYY-NNNNN reference and e-mails the acknowledgement.

flows.name: CG_Upload_Endpoint
flows.purpose: Stores the attachments of a submission, refusing any upload without a valid ticket.

flows.name: CG_Portal_Status_Check_Endpoint
flows.purpose: Answers a submitter's tracking request with the record's current status.

flows.name: CG_Portal_Support_Endpoint
flows.purpose: Opens a support case (CASE-XXXXXX) from the Portal and links it to the record it concerns.

flows.name: CG_Portal_Writeback_Endpoint
flows.purpose: Adds a submitter's note to their record and its status timeline.

flows.name: CG_Portal_Verification_Endpoint
flows.purpose: Sends a verification code to a submitter's e-mail address.

flows.name: CG_Portal_Verification_Confirmation_Endpoint
flows.purpose: Checks the verification code and locks out repeated wrong attempts.

flows.name: CG_Registry_Status_Notifier
flows.purpose: When a Portal record's status changes, e-mails the submitter the outcome.

flows.name: CG_Portal_Daily_Sweep
flows.purpose: Daily housekeeping of Portal records, recorded in telemetry.

flows.name: AUTO_SCHEDULED_SWEEP
flows.purpose: Working days at 08:45 WAT: one digest per officer of unacknowledged and overdue tasks, task reminders, support-case notices and alerts for messages that could not be delivered. Staff digests go to the registry mailbox until staff notifications are switched on.

flows.name: IP_FETCH_ALL_BOOTSTRAP
flows.purpose: Loads an officer's working data when the Workspace opens: documents, tasks, approvals, reference lists and the registry inbox, scoped to the officer's role.

flows.name: IP_Get_Docs_Endpoint
flows.purpose: Returns documents and activities for the Workspace's document views.

flows.name: IP_Reference_Data_Endpoint
flows.purpose: Returns the reference lists the Workspace's forms use.

flows.name: IP_Retrieve_Email_Attachment_Endpoint
flows.purpose: Retrieves the attachments of e-mails in the registry inbox.

flows.name: IP_Dynamic_Global_Actions_Endpoint
flows.purpose: Carries out governed changes to records: task updates, dispatch, comments, reminders and related actions.

flows.name: Single_Task_Assignment
flows.purpose: Assigns a document to an officer as a task and e-mails the assignment notice.
flows.note: Last run 10 Oct 2026 01:30 UTC: it created TASK-2026-00002 and sent the assignment notice, but is marked Failed because its reply to the caller timed out. That definition was replaced at 16:22 UTC the same day; the current one has not run since. Check the run history after the first assignment after go-live.

flows.name: BULK OPS DATA RETRIEVAL HTTP
flows.purpose: Assigns several documents in one operation and reports any that failed.

flows.name: IP_Create__Task__for_received_Email_Endpoint
flows.purpose: Raises a task from an e-mail received in the registry inbox.

flows.name: AI_Document_Processing
flows.purpose: AI analysis of documents, e-mails and chat. AI is switched off in the Workspace by decision (ITEM-88).
flows.note: Runs only when AI analysis is switched on in the Workspace; it is off by decision (ITEM-88). Last run 8 Oct 2026, cancelled.

flows.name: Folio_Incoming_Correspondence_Scan_Processing_Flow
flows.purpose: Turns each scan saved to /E-DOCUMENT STATION into a registry record and notifies dgs@nitda.gov.ng ("New E-Scan").

flows.name: Folio_Failure_Watch
flows.purpose: Hourly on working days: reports newly failed notices to the registry and records the failure count per group for System Health.

flows.name: IP_OTP_VERIFY
flows.purpose: Verifies a staff member's sign-in code and issues the session proof every governed call carries.

flows.name: IP_OTP_GENERATE
flows.purpose: Sends a one-time sign-in code to a staff member's work e-mail.

flows.name: IP_User_Admin_Endpoint
flows.purpose: Adds, changes and disables staff access and roles (User Administration).

flows.name: IP_Activity_Lifecycle_Endpoint
flows.purpose: Records activities and routes them to SIWES, NYSC or the archive.

flows.name: IP_SCAN_INTAKE
flows.purpose: Registers a document deposited at the registry counter from the Workspace's Scan Intake screen.

flows.name: IP_SEND_EMAIL
flows.purpose: Sends e-mail for the Workspace (staff notices, responses dispatched through the Correspondence Email Desk) and writes a delivery receipt.

flows.name: DGSO INCOMING AI PROCESSING
flows.purpose: The former library intake. Replaced by the scan processing flow and turned off by design on 16 October 2026 (ITEM-80).

flows.name: 01 - GOV - Provision HTTP Flow Registry
flows.purpose: Creates and validates the seven HTTP flow registry lists, their settings and views, and e-mails a provisioning report.

flows.name: 02 - GOV - Register HTTP Flow Truth
flows.purpose: Records a flow's contract and definition fingerprint in the registry.

flows.name: 03 - GOV - Record HTTP Flow Execution
flows.purpose: Writes a flow run to the execution ledger.
flows.note: Runs on request; not yet needed.

flows.name: 04 - GOV - Audit HTTP Flow Registry
flows.purpose: Nightly audit of the registry for stale, failing or non-compliant flows.

flows.name: 05 - GOV - Retire HTTP Flow
flows.purpose: Retires a flow from the registry.
flows.note: Runs on request; not yet needed.

flows.name: 06 - GOV - Registry Exception Notification
flows.purpose: Hourly: e-mails open governance exceptions.

flows.name: 07 - GOV - Consumer HTTP Self-Registration Template
flows.purpose: The template a consuming system uses to register itself with the registry.
flows.note: A template; runs on request; not yet needed.

flows.name: 08 - GOV - Discover and Register HTTP Consumers
flows.purpose: Nightly discovery and registration of the systems that call HTTP flows.

flows.name: DGO_MAIL_AUTH
flows.purpose: Operator sign-in: codes, 12-hour sessions and the operator list.

flows.name: DGO_MAIL_DATA
flows.purpose: Mailings, their results and the Activity reports.

flows.name: DGO_MAIL_DIRECTORY
flows.purpose: The directory of institutions and addressees.

flows.name: DGO_MAIL_LOG
flows.purpose: The send log and its export.

flows.name: DGO_MAIL_PROVISION
flows.purpose: Creates the Mailer's SharePoint lists and library.

flows.name: DGO_MAIL_SEND
flows.purpose: Sends each personalised letter with its attachments.

flows.name: DGO_MAIL_TEMPLATES
flows.purpose: Letter templates and the signatory.
